ngspice-buck.review_note: Reviewed switching Buck reference solve path. Update only with an explicit model-review record; a changed digest means the numerical construction, execution, or parsing code changed. 0.5.1: the reviewed-identity module moved from pe_sim/backends/identity.py to pe_sim/identity.py and the adapters import it from the package root; digests were recomputed after that import-only change, no numerical code was modified. 0.5.2: the adapter now declares a class-level backend_id so the kernel can recompute its reviewed identity instead of trusting the self-reported record; the netlist template, solver settings, process invocation, and wrdata parsing are untouched. 0.13.0 (ADR 0004 step 2): the window netlist renders the PWM carrier delay as the time to the next absolute carrier start ((-phase) mod Tsw) instead of restarting at zero; the constructor no longer requires the control period to be an integer multiple of the switching period; the adapter solves exactly to the end of the current control window and lets a change point inside that window force a re-solve; the Runner ends a solve segment at the next external-input change point. Acceptance: tests/test_event_boundaries.py (D2 1.5x ratio vs one direct run; A4 mid-window load step vs boundary counterfactual and vs one long window; D3 non-zero difference; route declares continuous). Template version bumped to ngspice-buck-v2; Tsw, duty, device models, solver settings, process invocation, and wrdata parsing are otherwise untouched.

buck.review_note: Reviewed native averaged Buck reference solve path (reference_plants.py: averaged equations, RK4 integrator, analytical equilibrium).
